```{r}
#install packages (see ../requirements.txt)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rvest)
```


```{r}
#setting directories: 
# input data (the analytical sample)
analysis_path <- file.path("..", "data", "analysis_data")
# create directory if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(analysis_path)) {
  dir.create(analysis_path)
}

out_dir <- file.path("..", "out")
dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# setting figure output directory
figures_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(
  figures_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

```{r load_data}
# analytical sample: 
df <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_path, "analysis_df.csv"))

# checking dataframe structure and dimensions
str(df) #should be comma-separated (3997 rows, 36 columns)

```
```{r}
#for analysis, transcription notes are omitted, and treated as NA:
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.character),
      ~ na_if(.x, "could_not_transcribe")
    )
  )

# changing data types:
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardizing dates from d-m-y to y-m-d
    admission_date = as.Date(admission_date, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
    discharge_date = as.Date(discharge_date, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
    date_of_birth = as.Date(date_of_birth, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),

    # Extracting years
    birth_year = lubridate::year(date_of_birth),
    admission_year = lubridate::year(admission_date),
    discharge_year = lubridate::year(discharge_date),

    # Factorizing defined categorical variables
    sex_series = factor(sex_series),
    sex = factor(sex),
    marital_status = factor(marital_status),

    # Numeric / sequential variables
    series_page = as.integer(series_page),
    crowd_id = as.integer(crowd_id),
    
    #cat:
    patient_key = as.character(patient_key)
  )

```


###  DESCRIPTIVE ANALYSES
```{r}
# Diagnoses columns
#what diagnostic language will I find? (not standardized)
diagnosis_counts <- df %>%
  count(diagnosis_at_admission, sort = TRUE)
diagnosis_counts
```
```{r}
# Standardizing diagnosis strings for analysis
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_standardized = diagnosis_at_admission %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]") %>%
      str_squish()%>%
      na_if(""),

    diagnosis_standardized = case_when(
      str_detect(diagnosis_standardized, "obs") ~ "obs",
      TRUE ~ diagnosis_standardized
    ),

    diagnosis_standardized = recode(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      !!!diagnosis_recode,
      .default = diagnosis_standardized
    )
  )
# Recoding obvious textual variants
diagnosis_recode <- c(
  "melank" = "melankoli",
  "mel"    = "melankoli",
  "melancholi" = "melankoli",
  "melanch" = "melankoli",
  "mekankoli" = "melankoli",
  "melankol" = "melankoli",
  "forv" = "forvirring",
  "dements" = "demens",
  "dementia" = "demens",
  "mani period" = "mani periodisk",
  "firrykthed" = "forrykthed",
  "forrkt" = "forrykthed",
  "forrykhed" = "forrykthed",
  "forrykt" = "forrykthed",
  "dem prac" = "dementia præcox",
  "dem præcox"= "dementia præcox",
  "dem præc" = "dementia præcox",
  "dem pre" = "dementia præcox"
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_standardized = recode(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      !!!diagnosis_recode,
      .default = diagnosis_standardized
    )
  )

# viewing the standardized diagnoses
clean_diagnosis_counts <- df %>%
  count(diagnosis_standardized, sort = TRUE)
clean_diagnosis_counts

cat("Number of clean diagnosis:", nrow(clean_diagnosis_counts)) #495

```

```{r}
# Comparing diagnoses across the two archival series
diagnosis_by_series <- df %>%
  count(
    sex_series,
    diagnosis_standardized
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex_series) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sex_series, desc(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

diagnosis_by_series
```

```{r}
# Top 10 most frequent standardized diagnoses overall
top_10_diagnoses <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(diagnosis_standardized)) %>%
  count(diagnosis_standardized, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(diagnosis_standardized)

# Overall: top 10 diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diagnosis_standardized),
    !is.na(admission_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(admission_year) %>%
  mutate(total_diagnoses = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(diagnosis_standardized %in% top_10_diagnoses) %>%
  count(
    admission_year,
    diagnosis_standardized,
    total_diagnoses
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / total_diagnoses,
    diagnosis_standardized = factor(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      levels = top_10_diagnoses
    )
  )

# By sex: same top 10 diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time_sex <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diagnosis_standardized),
    !is.na(admission_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex_series, admission_year) %>%
  mutate(total_diagnoses = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(diagnosis_standardized %in% top_10_diagnoses) %>%
  count(
    sex_series,
    admission_year,
    diagnosis_standardized,
    total_diagnoses
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / total_diagnoses,
    diagnosis_standardized = factor(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      levels = top_10_diagnoses
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Plotting overall distribution of diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time_plot <- ggplot(
  diagnosis_over_time,
  aes(
    x = admission_year,
    y = proportion,
    color = diagnosis_standardized
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1889, 1914, by = 2)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    labels = \(x) str_to_sentence(x)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Most Frequent Diagnoses Over Time",
    subtitle = "Ten most frequently recorded diagnoses overall",
    x = "Admission year",
    y = "Proportion within year",
    color = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

diagnosis_over_time_plot
```

### INFERENTIAL ANALYSES 
```{r}
# Analytical subset: top 10 diagnoses overall
diagnosis_inferential_df <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sex_series),
    diagnosis_standardized %in% top_10_diagnoses
  )

# Contingency table
diagnosis_table <- table(
  diagnosis_inferential_df$sex_series,
  diagnosis_inferential_df$diagnosis_standardized
)

diagnosis_table

# Chi-square test
diagnosis_chisq <- chisq.test(diagnosis_table)

diagnosis_chisq
diagnosis_chisq$expected
diagnosis_chisq$stdres
```
